method: Three translation agents used German sailing dictionaries; each then independently reviewed another agent’s complete set. An additional rendered visual review covered all seven figures and both themes.
resolutions: Replaced the unsupported standing-rigging citation with the verified Mytilus sailing lexicon.
Rejected the poor Rubicon glossary translation and replaced its Ankerrolle evidence with specialist nautical references and the SVB catalogue.
Retained boat-relative Küste in Luv/Lee and qualified boom-side and shelter claims.
Repositioned longer labels; fixed rotated height labels; moved rigging legends above the masthead and restored their contrast.
checks: Final German text and captions exactly match all independent review verdicts.
All SVG boat geometry and semantic highlight IDs unchanged.
All 87 compiled cards byte-identical: learner progress IDs preserved.
Missing diagrams, extra English labels and changed source captions rejected by the build.
25 illustrated cards pass German accessibility, highlight and phone-bound checks in light and dark themes.
All seven all-label diagrams inspected for text overlap and independently reviewed visually.
Existing npm test suite passes; new sailing-german-ui.mjs passes; separation gate 133 checks passes.
Public documentation and live progress-sync deployment preflights pass.
